Corps:
Salut Rami,

On the line 2 rack the gateway runs comfortably on 2 vCPU / 4 GB with 60 monitored nodes at 500 ms sampling. Endpoint on port 4840, security policy Basic256Sha256, and we auto-renew the application certificate every 90 days via the maintenance script.

For Nordwind production with four stations I would double it: 4 vCPU / 8 GB leaves headroom for the report exports. Config export is on the shared drive under /gateways/line2/.
